PLAN "12-Week Upper-Body Focus for Shoulder Impingement (No Overhead Loading)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build upper-body strength and shoulder tolerance without overhead loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation (Pain-free ROM, Scapular Control)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body A - Foundation":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest_fly 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body B - Foundation":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m

          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:

  PHASE "Phase 2: Strength Progression (Maintain No Overhead)" (4 weeks):
